You stumbled upon a mushroom-covered miner in a flooded mine. His face shows apathy and longing - it's hard to tell if he's even alive.
Coming closer, you see that the poor man has long been dead. Searching the body, you find something useful.
You find a few coins, but as you pull your hand out of his pocket, the madman bites your hand.
You apply a potion to the moss-covered mouth of the poor man. He doesn't seem able to move, but you notice tears forming in his eyes. A moment later, he falls asleep forever.
You approach and see that the man is literally rooted to the cave. You try to cut the growths holding his body. The miner lets out a groan, breaks free from his bonds, and lunges at you.
